description: Merge multiple PDF files into one combined PDF document on disk. Combines the pages and remaps takeoff keys from all source documents. Coordinates are image px at render scale 2.0: PDF pt × 2, origin top-left, y down (the browser canvas's native space). Sheet payloads carry dims in both px and pt.

files.description: List of PDF files to merge in order (can be loaded file names or file paths on disk)

output_path.description: Destination path for the merged PDF

overwrite.description: Replace the file at path even when it is not an OpenTakeoff export. Off by default: re-exporting over a previous export of your own already overwrites without this, so you only need it to deliberately destroy an unrelated file.

name: merge_documents
